title: Geographic Catalogue and Selection-Bias Firewall
negative_results: inflating the search space (many candidates x catalogue entries) raises the look-everywhere adjusted probability toward chance
a match significant after correction but lacking a prospective test is only an OPERATOR_HYPOTHESIS, never evidence
treating a catalogue match as evidence without a prospective test is refused via refuse_catalogue_match_as_evidence
an empty catalogue, a non-positive match radius, and n_candidates < 1 are refused

claims.statement: Scoring a candidate against a catalogue reports the search-space size (n_candidates x catalogue size) and a Sidak family-wise adjusted probability; a tight match in a small space is significant while the same match in a huge space is expected by chance.
A match to a famous catalogue site is refused as evidence of intended encoding without a passed prospective test.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic catalogue with invented coordinates only, no private inputs
